ex.en: The new store will officially open next Monday.
ex.zh: 新店將於下週一正式開幕。

ex.en: The company has not officially announced the merger yet.
ex.zh: 公司尚未正式宣布合併。

officially.en: in a way that is approved by those in authority

ex.en: Higher prices offset the drop in sales.
ex.zh: 價格上漲抵銷了銷量的下滑。

ex.en: We plant trees to offset our carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 我們種樹來抵銷碳排放。

offset.en: to balance something so that its effect is reduced

ex.en: Taiwan is building offshore wind farms.
ex.zh: 台灣正在興建離岸風場。

ex.en: He kept his money in an offshore account.
ex.zh: 他把錢存在境外帳戶。

offshore.en: in the sea near the land, or in another country

ex.en: Many companies moved production offshore.
ex.zh: 許多公司把生產線移到海外。

ex.en: The ship was anchored offshore.
ex.zh: 那艘船停泊在離岸處。

offshore.en: to or in a place in another country

ex.en: The speaker's comments were highly offensive.
ex.zh: 那位講者的言論非常冒犯人。

ex.en: I found his joke rather offensive.
ex.zh: 我覺得他的笑話很冒犯人。

ex.en: The team needs a stronger offensive strategy.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍需要更強的進攻策略。

ex.en: He is the team's best offensive player.
ex.zh: 他是隊上最好的進攻球員。

offensive.en: used for attacking or trying to win

offensive.zh: 攻勢（charm offensive 魅力攻勢）

ex.en: The company launched a marketing offensive.
ex.zh: 公司發動了一波行銷攻勢。

ex.en: The new CEO began a charm offensive to win back customers.
ex.zh: 新任執行長展開魅力攻勢，想贏回顧客。

offensive.en: a strong and planned effort to achieve something

ex.en: Turn off the lights before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前把燈關掉。

ex.en: The TV is off.
ex.zh: 電視是關著的。

off.en: not working, or not switched on

ex.en: I'm off tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天休假。

ex.en: Tom took the day off.
ex.zh: 湯姆今天請假。

ex.en: Everything is 20% off today.
ex.zh: 今天全面八折。

ex.en: You can get 10% off with this coupon.
ex.zh: 用這張優惠券可以打九折。

off.en: lower in price by a stated amount

ex.en: I'm off to work now.
ex.zh: 我要去上班了。

ex.en: The bus drove off before I got there.
ex.zh: 我還沒到，公車就開走了。

off.en: away from a place, or starting a journey

ex.en: The picnic was called off because of the rain.
ex.zh: 野餐因為下雨取消了。

ex.en: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
ex.zh: 棒球比賽因雨取消了。

off.en: to decide that a planned event will not happen

ex.en: He often sits by me and listens to music.
ex.zh: 他常坐在我旁邊聽音樂。

ex.en: He often walks with his hand in his pocket.
ex.zh: 他走路時常把一隻手插在口袋裡。

ex.en: You've been late for school more often than before.
ex.zh: 你上學遲到的次數比以前多了。

often.en: many times, or in many cases

ex.en: How often do you have to see the dentist?
ex.zh: 你多久要看一次牙醫？

ex.en: How often do you wash your car a month?
ex.zh: 你一個月洗幾次車？

often.en: used to ask how many times something happens

ex.en: We have a door between our offices.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室之間有一扇門。

ex.en: I went home and Bill stayed at the office.
ex.zh: 我回家了，比爾留在辦公室。

office.en: a room or building where people do desk work

ex.en: Hundreds of people were waiting outside the ticket office.
ex.zh: 售票處外面有數百人在等候。

ex.en: Where is the nearest post office?
ex.zh: 最近的郵局在哪裡？

office.en: a place where a service is given to the public

ex.en: The mayor has been in office for two years.
ex.zh: 市長已經上任兩年了。

ex.en: She took office in January.
ex.zh: 她在一月就任。

office.en: an important job or position of power in the government

ex.en: There were ten police officers on the spot.
ex.zh: 現場有十名警員。

ex.en: How did you become a police officer?
ex.zh: 你是怎麼成為一名警察的？

ex.en: There's a police officer at the door.
ex.zh: 門口有位警察。

ex.en: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場被海關人員搜查。

ex.en: She is the company's chief financial officer.
ex.zh: 她是公司的財務長。

officer.en: a person who holds an important job in an organization

ex.en: That is a criminal offense, and you will surely be punished!
ex.zh: 那是刑事犯罪，你一定會受到懲罰！

ex.en: Driving without a license is a serious offense.
ex.zh: 無照駕駛是嚴重的違法行為。

offense.en: an act that breaks the law

ex.en: No offense, but I don't agree with you.
ex.zh: 無意冒犯，但我不同意你的看法。

ex.en: I didn't mean to cause any offense.
ex.zh: 我無意冒犯任何人。

offense.en: a feeling of being upset because of something rude

ex.en: Our team needs a stronger offense.
ex.zh: 我們隊需要更強的進攻。

ex.en: Their offense scored three times in the first half.
ex.zh: 他們的進攻在上半場得了三分。

offense.en: the players in a team who try to score points

ex.en: We are running low on office supplies such as paper and pens.
ex.zh: 我們的紙、筆等辦公用品快用完了。

ex.en: Amy is in charge of ordering office supplies.
ex.zh: Amy 負責訂購辦公用品。

office supplies.en: items such as paper and pens that are used for desk work

ex.en: Parents want the best for their offspring.
ex.zh: 父母都希望給孩子最好的。

ex.en: The bird feeds its offspring insects.
ex.zh: 這種鳥用昆蟲餵養幼鳥。

offspring.en: a person's child or children, or the young of an animal

ex.en: The atomic bomb is the offspring of 20th century physics.
ex.zh: 原子彈是二十世紀物理學的產物。

ex.en: The new company is the offspring of a merger.
ex.zh: 這家新公司是合併後的產物。

offspring.en: something that comes from or is the result of something else

ex.en: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
ex.zh: 聯邦、州和地方官員立刻承諾會重建。

ex.en: The number of officials doubled last year.
ex.zh: 去年官員人數增加了一倍。

official.en: a person who holds a position of authority in an organization

ex.en: Thai is the official language of Thailand.
ex.zh: 泰文是泰國的官方語言。

ex.en: James Cameron personally did the official promotion!
ex.zh: 詹姆斯．卡麥隆親自官宣！

official.en: approved by or coming from those in authority

ex.en: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
ex.zh: 你接受他的提議真是太傻了。

ex.en: I had no choice but to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 我別無選擇，只能接受這個提議。

ex.en: She received a job offer from a bank.
ex.zh: 她收到一家銀行的錄取通知。

offer.en: something that you say you will give or do for someone

ex.en: He offered his seat to an old woman.
ex.zh: 他把座位讓給一位老太太。

ex.en: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
ex.zh: 這個神話讓我們得以了解古代文明。

offer.en: to say that you will give or do something for someone

ex.en: I meant no offence by my joke.
ex.zh: 我開那個玩笑並無冒犯之意。

ex.en: He took offence at her words.
ex.zh: 他對她的話感到不悅。

ex.en: Parking here is an offence.
ex.zh: 在這裡停車是違規的。

ex.en: It was his first offence, so the fine was small.
ex.zh: 那是他的初犯，所以罰款不多。

ex.en: Repeat offenders may have to pay a much higher fine.
ex.zh: 累犯可能必須繳交高得多的罰款。

ex.en: The police caught the offender a few hours later.
ex.zh: 警方幾小時後逮到了這名違法者。

ex.en: People left offerings of fruit at the temple.
ex.zh: 人們在廟裡供奉水果。

ex.en: The villagers made an offering to the gods.
ex.zh: 村民向神明獻上供品。

ex.en: The restaurant has a new offering this season.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳這一季推出了新品。

ex.en: Their latest offering is a cheaper phone.
ex.zh: 他們最新推出的產品是一支比較便宜的手機。

ex.en: This is a photo of my family.
ex.zh: 這是一張我家人的照片。

ex.en: The color of the sky changed at sunset.
ex.zh: 天空的顏色在日落時改變了。

ex.en: She is a good friend of mine.
ex.zh: 她是我的一位好朋友。

ex.en: I hope my joke didn't offend you.
ex.zh: 我希望我的玩笑沒有冒犯到你。

ex.en: Some people are easily offended by rude words.
ex.zh: 有些人很容易被粗魯的話冒犯。

ex.en: She never meant to offend her neighbors.
ex.zh: 她從沒打算得罪鄰居。

ex.en: People who offend again may face a longer sentence.
ex.zh: 再次犯罪的人可能面臨更長的刑期。

ex.en: The young man offended and was sent to court.
ex.zh: 那名年輕人犯了罪，被送上了法庭。

ex.en: Hotels are much cheaper in the offseason.
ex.zh: 飯店在淡季便宜許多。

ex.en: The team signed two new players during the offseason.
ex.zh: 球隊在休賽期簽下了兩名新球員。

ex.en: The server is offline for maintenance until noon.
ex.zh: 伺服器因維護暫時離線，直到中午。

ex.en: You can read the offline version of the article without internet.
ex.zh: 你可以在沒有網路時閱讀這篇文章的離線版本。

ex.en: You can work offline and sync your files later.
ex.zh: 你可以離線工作，之後再同步檔案。

ex.en: The game still runs when you play offline.
ex.zh: 離線遊玩時遊戲仍能運作。

ex.en: The mechanic found the offending part and replaced it.
ex.zh: 技師找出有問題的零件並換掉了。

ex.en: Please remove the offending file from your computer.
ex.zh: 請把電腦裡有問題的檔案刪除。

ex.en: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be offending anyone.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我並不是有意要冒犯任何人。

ex.en: He keeps offending his neighbors by playing loud music.
ex.zh: 他老是放大聲音樂，冒犯了鄰居。

ex.en: Oftentimes the simplest solution is the best one.
ex.zh: 最簡單的解法往往就是最好的。

ex.en: Oftentimes I wake up before my alarm rings.
ex.zh: 我常常在鬧鐘響之前就醒了。

ex.en: The small company is an offshoot of a larger firm.
ex.zh: 這家小公司是一家大企業的分支。

ex.en: Jazz rock is an offshoot of traditional jazz.
ex.zh: 爵士搖滾是傳統爵士樂衍生出來的類型。

ex.en: The cafe is known for its offbeat decorations.
ex.zh: 這間咖啡廳以不落俗套的裝飾聞名。

ex.en: She has an offbeat sense of humor that I really enjoy.
ex.zh: 她有種獨特古怪的幽默感，我很喜歡。

ex.en: The drummer hit the offbeat with the snare.
ex.zh: 鼓手用小鼓敲出弱拍。

ex.en: Clap on the offbeat instead of the first beat.
ex.zh: 在弱拍而不是第一拍拍手。

ex.en: The oft repeated story never failed to make us laugh.
ex.zh: 這個經常被重複講的故事總是讓我們大笑。

ex.en: An oft quoted saying reminds us to be kind.
ex.zh: 一句常被引用的諺語提醒我們要善良。

ex.en: She will officiate at the final match tomorrow.
ex.zh: 她明天將擔任決賽的裁判。

ex.en: Only qualified referees can officiate in this league.
ex.zh: 只有合格的裁判才能在這個聯賽執法。

ex.en: A judge will officiate at their wedding.
ex.zh: 一位法官將主持他們的婚禮。

ex.en: The priest officiated at the funeral.
ex.zh: 神父主持了葬禮。

ex.en: He spoke offensively to the waiter.
ex.zh: 他對服務生的說話方式很無禮。

ex.en: The room smelled offensively of old fish.
ex.zh: 房間裡有一股令人作嘔的腐魚味。

ex.en: The hotel offered us a free breakfast.
ex.zh: 旅館提供我們免費早餐。

ex.en: He offered to drive me to the airport.
ex.zh: 他主動表示要開車送我去機場。

ex.en: Dealing with officialdom can take a lot of time.
ex.zh: 與官僚體系打交道可能很花時間。

ex.en: He was tired of the endless rules of officialdom.
ex.zh: 他受夠了官僚體制沒完沒了的規定。

ex.en: We heard an offscreen voice explaining the story.
ex.zh: 我們聽到畫面外有個聲音在解說故事。

ex.en: The actor is very shy in his offscreen life.
ex.zh: 這位演員在戲外的生活中很害羞。

ex.en: She looked offscreen as if waiting for a signal.
ex.zh: 她看向鏡頭外，彷彿在等待信號。

ex.en: The two actors were friends both on and offscreen.
ex.zh: 這兩位演員在戲裡戲外都是朋友。

ex.en: There may be some changes in the offing at our company.
ex.zh: 我們公司可能即將有一些變動。

ex.en: With a storm in the offing, the sailors returned to port.
ex.zh: 暴風雨即將來臨，水手們回到了港口。

ex.en: "Can you help me?" "Of course."
ex.zh: 「你可以幫我嗎？」「當然。」

ex.en: Of course I remember your name.
ex.zh: 我當然記得你的名字。

of course.en: used to say yes or to show something is obvious

ex.en: Off the record, the manager told me the plan might change.
ex.zh: 私下說，經理告訴我這個計畫可能會改。

ex.en: She spoke off the record, so the reporter could not use her words.
ex.zh: 她是私下談話，所以記者不能引用她的話。

off the record.en: said privately and not to be reported or quoted

off the hook.zh: 脫身、擺脫責任（let sb off the hook）

ex.en: The teacher let him off the hook this time.
ex.zh: 老師這次放過他了。

ex.en: I'm off the hook now that Tom has agreed to drive.
ex.zh: 湯姆答應開車，我就不用負責了。

off the hook.en: free from blame or from a difficult duty

ex.en: The phone was off the hook, so nobody could call us.
ex.zh: 電話沒掛好，所以沒人打得進來。

ex.en: Someone left the receiver off the hook all night.
ex.zh: 有人整晚都沒把話筒掛好。

off the hook.en: not placed correctly on its base, so the phone is in use
